purpose: Prospective revision registry addressing near-boundary inner multiplicity, directional error budgets, alpha-allocation sensitivity, and a new AIM mechanism replication.

primary_outcomes: familywise probability of recognizing at least one invalid release
familywise probability of validating at least one boundary-reliable mechanism

alpha_allocation.selection_rule: The split is fixed before outcomes; no allocation is selected post hoc. The paper reports the full registered grid.

aim.seed_sampling: The 25 seeds were drawn before release generation from NumPy default_rng(260728), uniformly over integers [100000, 2147483647). The first seed also fixes a new 60/20/20 data split.

prospective_aim_mechanism.primary_outcome: mechanism status under the separate validation and violation guarantees
prospective_aim_mechanism.analysis_status: Prospectively registered replication with a new target split and newly sampled release seeds. The choice of AIM epsilon=1 was informed by the earlier retrospective AIM analysis and is disclosed as such.
prospective_aim_mechanism.privacy_scope: AIM retains its own differential privacy parameters. ProxyGuard evaluates registered downstream transfer and does not add a privacy guarantee.
